_comment: Canonical mapping of /docs/r/<slug>.html static-redirect entries. Each entry is a meta-refresh redirect served from GitHub Pages, which means the redirecting page itself gets logged in GitHub's Traffic > Popular Content panel. This is Halvor's referrer-approximation attribution mechanism until a real analytics surface (Loops form / Vercel edge log / Cloudflare Analytics) is wired. See docs/index.html for the shipping context and RECEIPTS.md for the numbers.
_ship_slot: 2026-08-23 Sun 3pm-build (resurrection Week 2 Day 7 bonus, pulled forward from W3 Priority 1 Mon 3pm-build target).
_bottleneck_this_addresses: ORGANIC-CLONE-SIGNAL-WITHOUT-ATTRIBUTION-FLOOR (Sun 2026-08-23 9pm-close bottleneck naming candidate). 23 clones / 18 uniques cumulative through Sun 12:08Z with 0 referrer + 0 view. Every clone is invisible. This surface changes that for URLs a human can hit.
